system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Helm of Telepathy). Put on, make a Will save (DC 17) or your Outlook turns to its opposite, good to evil and law to chaos. Only wish or miracle turns it back, even after the helm is gone.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
At will, cast Detect Thoughts (Will DC 13) and speak mind to mind with whoever you read. Once per day, cast Suggestion (Will DC 13).

Rarity: Uncommon
